title: Ip Man 4: The Finale
description: Ip Man and his son encounter racial discrimination after traveling to the United States to seek a better life.

title: Master Z: Ip Man Legacy
description: Defeated by Master Ip, martial arts expert Cheung Tin Chi tries to lead a normal life in Hong Kong until triad leaders draw him back into fighting.

title: Day of the Dead
description: The living dead regroup above while humans (Lori Cardille, Terry Alexander, Joseph Pilato) sweat it out below in a Florida missile silo.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E01 — Pilot
Bank robbers Seth and Richie Gecko head for the Mexican border, encountering a deadly standoff at a liquor store along the way; Richie is haunted by visions of demons and a mysterious woman.

title: The Director's Chair
description:
S02 E01 — Jon Favreau
Jon has a seat in the Director's Chair.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E02 — Pre-Production Begins
Pre-production forges on as the filmmakers are forced to make huge decisions regarding everything from props and gear, exposing who has the experience when it comes to production, and who could fall behind.

title: American Ninja
description: A GI (Michael Dudikoff) rescues a colonel's daughter (Judie Aronson) and fights an arms dealer's ninjas in the Philippines.

title: American Ninja 2: The Confrontation
description: Army Rangers (Michael Dudikoff, Steve James) catch a drug lord sorting genes of Marines to create ninja assassins.

title: American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt
description: An expert fighter (David Bradley) leads an assault on the island lab of a madman (Marjoe Gortner) making a virus for terrorists.

title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
description: An ex-ninja (Michael Dudikoff) must save commandos and the world from a mad sheik and his ninja army.

title: Haywire
description: After a successful mission to free a Chinese hostage, a highly trained operative (Gina Carano) is betrayed and left for dead by someone in her own agency.

title: The Condemned
description: A death-row inmate from a Central American jail is among the prisoners taken to a remote island for a to-the-death match broadcast live over the Internet.

title: The Condemned 2
description: A former bounty hunter (Randy Orton) lands in a tournament where convicts fight to the death for an online audience.

title: The Return of Swamp Thing
description: A mad scientist's (Louis Jourdan) vegetarian stepdaughter (Heather Locklear) falls in love with one of his leafy failures.

title: Dead Snow 2: Red vs. Dead
description: Martin mistakenly thinks things could not get worse after he kills his girlfriend with an ax, cuts off his arm with a chainsaw, and watches his friends be devoured by Nazi zombies.

title: Candyman 3
description: A woman (Donna D'Errico) tries to disprove a legend that her ancestor (Tony Todd) can appear and kill people with his hook.

title: The Last Stand
description: A sheriff must take matters into his own hands when a notorious drug lord escapes from FBI custody and comes speeding toward a showdown in the lawman's quiet border town.

title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Part 2
description: A retired Texas Ranger pursues a killer named Leatherface and his family of chainsaw-wielding cannibals.

title: Machete Kills
description: The president recruits ex-Federale Machete to take down an eccentric arms dealer who plans to spread war and anarchy throughout the world.

description:

Robert Zemeckis discusses his career.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E02 — Blood Runs Thick
The Gecko brothers flee the liquor store with Ranger Freddie Gonzalez in pursuit; Richie's visions escalate; the Geckos nearly collide with the Fullers, a troubled family making its own desperate journey to Mexico.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E03 — Casting Actors
Casting proves to be difficult as Alejandro's main actor unexpectedly drops out of the film, forcing him to rethink the role; Scarlet succumbs to the stress of finding talent that will work under her budgetary restraints.

title: Primal
description: Hunter and collector Frank Walsh sails to America with a priceless white jaguar and a dangerous political assassin. When the prisoner manages to break free, Walsh must utilize his expert skills to capture the dangerous killer -- not dead, but alive.

title: The Delta Force
description: Terrorists reroute a passenger jet from Athens to Beirut, where commandos (Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin) are waiting to negotiate.

description: The true story of the Von Erich brothers, who, through tragedy and triumph, under the shadow of their domineering father and coach, seek epic immortality on the biggest stage in sports.

description: Frank Castle, known as the Punisher, ruthlessly demolishes organized crime, but it starts an even bigger war.

description:
S01 E03 — Quentin Tarantino - Vol. 1
Rodriguez interviews his long-time friend and co-collaborator, Quentin Tarantino; the pair discuss screen writing, camera placement and various film genres.

title: The Director's Chair
description:
S01 E04 — Quentin Tarantino - Vol. 2
Quentin Tarantino continues discussing his career and various aspects of directing.
